environment: Apple M4, 16 GiB, macOS 27, Swift 6.4, release -O, 1280x820
method: Three paired rounds; round 1 and 3 switching/catalog/combined baseline then candidate, round 2 combined/catalog/switching candidate then baseline. No event-to-photon, FPS, hardware IME or SSH claim.
